findings.summary: Requirement R2 (Static Output Generation) is not substantively addressed in Milestone M2, despite the specific compliance check expecting M2 coverage. The plan explicitly schedules the full static asset emission (DL24) in Milestone M4.

evidence.note: M2 deliverables focus exclusively on ingestion, metadata, and exclusion. No output generation is listed.
R2 is explicitly claimed in M4 deliverables.
evidence.quote: Emit Plugin (C17) fully writing HTML pages and static assets to output directory (R2).

findings.summary: Requirement R3 (Markdown to HTML Parsing) is not satisfied in Milestone M2, despite the compliance check expectation and a citation in DL9. DL9 only covers reading raw content; the actual Parsing and HTML generation defined in R3 is scheduled for Milestone M4 (DL19).

evidence.note: DL9 in M2 cites R3 but only describes 'reading file contents' and 'populating shared context', not generating HTML.
evidence.quote: Full Ingestion Plugin (C11) reading file contents ... including raw Markdown and metadata (R1, R3).

evidence.note: The actual conversion to HTML required by R3 is defined in M4.
evidence.quote: Markdown Render Plugin (C14) converting Markdown to HTML ... (R3, R4, R21).

findings.summary: Deterministic sample check for R2 maps the requirement to milestones M1 and M2, but the plan’s concrete implementation of static-site emission (full HTML/CSS/JS assets) is scheduled in M4 (DL24). M1 explicitly describes only a skeleton emit plugin that writes placeholder output, which is insufficient to satisfy R2.

evidence.quote: "Emit Plugin (C17) fully writing HTML pages and static assets to output directory (R2)."

M1–M2 cover ingestion and metadata/tag extraction, not HTML rendering for each Markdown file.

findings.summary: Deterministic sample check for R3 cites AT3 as the acceptance test, but AT3 validates page-count and exclusion behavior; it does not validate the “CommonMark-compliant syntax” part of R3. This makes the sample check semantically incomplete for the stated requirement text.

evidence.quote: "using at least CommonMark-compliant syntax"

evidence.note: AT3 checks mapping/count of generated pages and exclusions, not syntax compliance.
evidence.quote: "Count generated HTML note pages and verify a one-to-one mapping for non-excluded files."

findings.summary: Requirement R1 maps to milestone M1 but M1 deliverables only include a skeleton ingestion plugin that discovers files without reading contents; full ingestion (reading file contents and parsing front matter) is deferred to M2, creating a gap in R1 coverage at M1 exit.

findings.summary: Acceptance test AT1 is mapped to both M1 and M2, but AT1 pass criteria require discovery of exactly three .md files with a build log/manifest, which implies more than stub records; M1 exit criteria only verify partial AT1 (discovery), creating ambiguity in test ownership and exit gate.

evidence.note: M2 exit criteria claim full AT1 coverage.
evidence.quote: All .md files in a nested test fixture are ingested with correct raw content and front matter (AT1).
